details.effect: [fanfare] Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may put a Fable follower that costs 5 play points or less from among them onto your field. Put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. [act][cost02], [engage], put this card into its owner's cemetery: Select a Fable follower that costs 3 play points or less in your cemetery and put it onto your field.

issues: The activated ability incorrectly has `activateFrom: "cemetery"`; the source [act] ability is activated while this amulet is on the field. Change `activateFrom` to `field` or omit it.

The fanfare effect is overconstrained as `searchDeckSummonMultiple` with `maxTotalCost: 5`; the source says 'you may put a Fable follower that costs 5 play points or less'—a single optional summon, not a total-cost-based multi-summon. Encode it with a single-card top-5 search/summon effect that optionally puts 1 matching follower onto your field and puts the rest on the bottom.
